cohort: 93 very low birth weight infants (VLBWIs), 49 born to mothers with arterial hypertension and 44 in a control group
finding: Maternal hypertension, particularly preeclampsia, was not found to be a protective factor against morbidity, mortality, or developmental issues in VLBWIs up to 24 months of age.
mod_finding: Infants born to mothers in the maternal arterial hypertension group had a higher rate of cesarean section deliveries.
